name: chaintrees

scripts.deploy:all: cd contracts && node node_modules/hardhat/internal/cli/cli.js run scripts/deployAll.cjs
scripts.deploy:sepolia: cd contracts && node node_modules/hardhat/internal/cli/cli.js run scripts/deployAll.cjs --network sepolia
scripts.deploy:mumbai: cd contracts && node node_modules/hardhat/internal/cli/cli.js run scripts/deployAll.cjs --network mumbai
scripts.deploy:base-sepolia: cd contracts && node node_modules/hardhat/internal/cli/cli.js run scripts/deployAll.cjs --network baseSepolia
scripts.deploy:mainnet: cd contracts && node node_modules/hardhat/internal/cli/cli.js run scripts/deployAll.cjs --network mainnet
scripts.deploy:polygon: cd contracts && node node_modules/hardhat/internal/cli/cli.js run scripts/deployAll.cjs --network polygon
scripts.deploy:base: cd contracts && node node_modules/hardhat/internal/cli/cli.js run scripts/deployAll.cjs --network base
scripts.verify:sepolia: cd contracts && npx hardhat verify --network sepolia
scripts.verify:mumbai: cd contracts && npx hardhat verify --network mumbai
scripts.verify:mainnet: cd contracts && npx hardhat verify --network mainnet
scripts.verify:polygon: cd contracts && npx hardhat verify --network polygon
scripts.verify:base: cd contracts && npx hardhat verify --network base
